[!dolt] skip
# Test bd reopen command
bd init --prefix test --quiet
bd create 'Issue to reopen' --description 'Will be reopened' --json
extractid ISSUE
bd close $ISSUE --reason Done
stdout 'Closed'

bd reopen $ISSUE --reason 'Needs more work'
stdout 'Reopened'

bd show $ISSUE --json
jq '.[0].issue.status'
stdout '"open"'
jq '.[0].comments | length'
stdout '^1$'
